title: Look at Me
description: Cinematic idle camera that showcases your character
body:
Look at Me is a client-side cinematic camera mod for Fabric.
When you stand AFK, the camera becomes a gentle director: it circles around your character, focuses on the face, shows the held item, and creates smooth showcase shots — just like a hero preview in modern games.

The mod does not change gameplay, works in singleplayer and multiplayer, and requires no server installation.



**Compatibility**

Minecraft 1.21.x

Latest Fabric + Fabric API
